items.title: The Official Lord of the Rings Pizza Cutter Drops to a New Low Price at Amazon
items.content_text: Amazon's Black Friday sale is a great time to find discounts on things you actually need. It's also a great time to buy expensive gifts for yourself that you absolutely don't need. Somewhere in between those two extremes is where I like to do most of my online window shopping, which is what led me to this discount on the official Lord of the Rings Pizza Wheel. Amazon is currently offering a 20% discount, which drops the price down to $159.99 for the first time ever. It's a very expensive pizza cutter for sure, but it's also one of the coolest LOTR gifts for your kitchen you'll find anywhere. As someone who makes a lot of pizzas at home, I can attest to how important it is to have a good pizza cutter at your disposal. If you don't have a sharp enough blade, toppings get crushed and pepperonis do that thing where they disappear into the cracks of every cut. You're only going to get good pizza slices if you have a knife capable of cutting good slices. Dalstrong, the brand who makes this product, uses high-quality German X50CrMoV15 steel for their knives and pizza cutters. This gives them solid toughness and corrosion resistance that will help keep the blade sharper for longer. This type of steel isn't going to hold an edge nearly as long as the high-end Japanese variety, but it's fairly easy to sharpen and hone at home if the edge does get dull. Just don't go putting it in the dishwasher! As for the LOTR stuff that actually makes this pizza cutter cool, there's a lot to love in the design. The handle is made of ebony wood and copper accents with the Leaf of Lórien carved into it. The blade itself is left bare to ensure drag-free cutting, but both sides include different designs etched into the steel. On one side you get silhouettes of the members of The Fellowship of the Ring and on the other side you get an inscription written in Elvish. I can't actually read Elvish, but I hope it just says pizza multiple times. The pizza wheel also comes with a collector's pin and a leather sheath to help protect the blade. The whole thing ships in the kind of premium gift packaging that you'd expect from a nearly $200 pizza cutter. The 4K Movie Trilogy Is Also on Sale Today Amazon also has a great deal on the 4K collection going on right now that's worth checking out. This includes both the theatrical and extended editions of the film in full 4K UHD. If you're only streaming these movies with an HBO Max subscription, you're missing out on the full visual experience.

items.title: Actor Who Plays Mandy in GTA 6 Excitedly Speaks Out After Character Goes Viral
items.excerpt: Lexie Shoaibi, the actor who plays Mandy in GTA 6, is speaking out now that the game has been officially released worldwide.
items.content_text: Lexie Shoaibi, the actor who plays Mandy in GTA 6, is speaking out now that the game has been officially released worldwide. GTA 6 is finally here, and players have wasted no time looking up the actors behind some of its colorful cast of characters. As the days go on, more and more performers are revealing that they played a part in the game — and one of these is going particularly viral due to a mystery surrounding their character. The actor who plays Mandy, a character players encounter early in the game, identified herself as Lexie Shoaibi, an American model and actress based out of New York. She posted the news on her Instagram account on November 19, where she revealed that she provided both Mandy’s voice and motion capture. “She’s a lot of fun, so if you play the game, let me know if you find me,” she said. In another post , Shoabi thanked Rockstar for casting her in the game, writing, “Y’all there aren’t words!!!! Thank you so much for the love and support. This is crazy!! Ily forever!” Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead. Turn back now if you want to remain unspoiled! Mandy is a character who’s been put under the microscope due to a few odd details that players noticed in her home. If you’ve played the first few hours of the game, you’ll know that Jason gets called over to collect rent from Mandy, who says she won’t pay up until her sink is unclogged. Jason finds the source of the clog — all while fending off aggressive romantic advances from Mandy — which appears to be a human fingerbone. Mandy snatches it from Jason’s hand and runs off with it before he can get a good look at what it really is. A quick stroll through her home and backyard show even more disturbing bits, such as a body-sized hole in the back garden and tubs of acid. The trunk of her car has also been packed with tools that could feasibly be used to kidnap or kill a victim. With all this in mind, fans are convinced that Mandy is actually a serial killer who seduces her victims. (Jason’s loyalty to Lucia really paid off!) Commenters were quick to praise Shoabi for her performance as Mandy and joke about her uncomfortable, one-sided crush on Jason, with one joking, “Why’d you do that to a committed man?” “BRO. You had me in a chokehold, but I have to stay loyal to Lucia. Sorry Mandy!!” another said. “Mandy listen… Look, I know we got off on the wrong foot, ok? Give me another chance,” another wrote. If the serial killer theory is true, it means she might not be the only murderer around; fans also spotted references to Dexter in the game, prompting even more curiosity as to Mandy’s true intentions. items.title: GTA 6 Triggers Busiest Traffic Day in Comcast History
items.excerpt: Comcast has said GTA 6's launch triggered the busiest traffic day the company has seen since it was founded in 1963.
items.content_text: Comcast has said GTA 6 's launch triggered the busiest traffic day the company has seen since it was founded in 1963. The latest record broken by Rockstar Games' latest actually comes from one of the biggest media and technology companies in the United States. After previously reporting that Grand Theft Auto had led to a 4x increase in traffic on Xbox consoles November 18, Comcast has now confirmed that pre-loads for the day resulted in the busiest day it has ever seen – and it wasn't close. Comcast recorded peak traffic 31% higher than the average day and 9.6% higher than the previous record holder. Moreover, GTA 6 has resulted in five out of 10 of the busiest days the network has ever seen. Even more remarkable is the news that, as reported by Comcast, 24% of all of its internet traffic during peak times was from users downloading and playing the game. If Rockstar fans weren't playing GTA 6, they were watching it. Twitch traffic increased by almost 50% on November 18 and is continuing to rise in the days following that launch. GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, but thanks to the New Zealand trick , a massive chunk of players actually took their trip to Leonida hours early. It certainly helped boost traffic across the board, and in Comcast's case, it resulted in its busiest day ever. To put some of these numbers into perspective, the company shared a very relevant measurement. November 18 traffic generated on PlayStation and Xbox alone delivered enough data for one million homes to stream The Odyssey in 4K… for two days straight. It's shocking to see how GTA 6 affected Comcast, but then again, we've known Rockstar's new game would be a juggernaut when it eventually launched. The developer's parent company, Take-Two Interactive, reported that it had earned an unbelievable $3.79 billion in the first day after its release. That makes it not just the biggest video game launch of all time, but the biggest entertainment launch across any medium . Critics everywhere helped GTA 6 earn the title of highest-rated game of all time . IGN was included in that list after delivering a 10/10 review . We said, "Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played." items.title: Percy Jackson Actors Reveal They Watched Attack on Titan Fan Edits to Help Themselves Cry While Filming Emotional Scenes
items.excerpt: Walker Scobell and Aryan Simhadri revealed that they would watch Attack on Titan fan edits to help them prepare to film emotional scenes for Percy Jackson and the Olympians.
items.content_text: Walker Scobell and Aryan Simhadri revealed that they would watch Attack on Titan fan edits to help them prepare to film emotional scenes for Percy Jackson and the Olympians. Attack on Titan is one of the most popular anime series in the world, in no small part due to its tragic storylines and brutal, gory battles. It’s been more than a decade since the anime first released in 2013, and fans have been making AMVs of their favorite characters ever since — but these fans probably didn’t know that their creations would help high-profile actors tap into their emotions. Speaking at 92NY on a live episode of Josh Horowitz’s Happy Sad Confused podcast, Walker Scobell revealed his unique method for getting himself into an emotional state in preparation for sad scenes while filming Percy Jackson and the Olympians . Scobell said that he would watch fan-made edits for Eren and Mikasa, two of Attack on Titan’s main characters, set to the opening song of Season 3, Red Swan. “I was trying to get sad. I was in school, and I snuck my phone in. I was like, ‘What can I do to make myself cry?’ I searched up a bunch of — and he did the exact same thing, and we just figured this out yesterday,” Scobell said, pointing to co-star Aryan Simhadri. “We didn’t communicate this at all. We just ended up doing it,” Simhardi confirmed. “I thought of the saddest thing I could, and I searched up Eren and Mikasa edits from Attack on Titan,” Scobell continued. “I started crying at school, watching them to Red Swan. And then I got there [on set], and I couldn’t do it.” Walker & Aryan saying they watch eren & mikasa edits so they can cry on set is actually frying meee 😭😭😭 https://t.co/7JgZFv91Dr — ELON SMD (@pearlinasbeau) November 20, 2026 Fans in the crowd had excited reactions to this revelation, as did fans online when clips from the episode made their way on social media shortly thereafter. “Their tragedy is so profounddd everyone can feel it… oh they really are modern day Romeo and Juliet,” one fan wrote on X/Twitter. “Red Swan is a Top 3 OP, I don’t blame him,” another said. “The way they're emotionally regulating through anime edits on a professional set is the most Gen Z actor thing I've ever heard,” another remarked. It’s no wonder that actors take notes from Attack on Titan for their own projects; in fact, Eren’s English voice actor, Bryce Papenbrook, revealed that he literally unhinged his jaw while screaming in one of the anime’s most iconic scenes in an effort to really sell the character’s pain and confusion. Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3, The Titan’s Curse , is streaming on Disney+ and Hulu right now with new episodes dropping every Friday through December 11, 2026.

items.title: Save 33% Off the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Sport Headphone With Bone Conduction Tech for Black Friday
items.content_text: If you enjoy listening to music while you run or work out, then you should consider getting a headset that's specifically designed for it. Shokz is one of the best known and well-respected sport headphone brands and, fortunately for you, the Shokz Black Friday Sale has officially kicked off on Amazon . As part of this sale, Amazon has dropped the price of the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 open-ear wireless sport headphones in rose gold from $180 to just $119.99 with free shipping. All other colorways are on sale for $125, so stick with rose gold for the biggest savings. The OpenRun Pro 2 uses bone conduction technology to transmit sound without covering your ears. 33% Off the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Sport Headphones The OpenRun Pro 2 looks like a neckband style headphone except that a lightweight titanium band connecting the two ear pieces wraps around the back of your head instead of resting on your neck. This design does an excellent job of keeping everything in place, perfect for active exercise. Instead of the traditional method of sending sound vibrations to your eardrums, the OpenRun Pro uses bone conduction technology to send vibrations through your cheekbones directly to your inner ear. As such, the headphones are actually placed in front of your ear instead of on your ear. The biggest advantage is that you can fully hear your surroundings; if you like running on streets, for example, you'll be aware of everything that's going on around you while your music is playing. OpenRun Pro 2 is an obvious upgrade over the Open Run Pro The OpenRun Pro 2 is a substantial update over its predecessor. The most noticeable upgrade is arguably the switch from a proprietary magnetic charging cable to the USB Type-C standard. Another significant upgrade is the sound quality. While the original OpenRun Pro has good bass response, it is slightly hampered by the fact that it produces tiny vibrations that are noticeable and sometimes ticklish or distracting. The new OpenRun Pro 2 utilizes Shok's DualPitch technology to virtually eliminate vibrations. Other smaller changes include increased battery life and improved mic quality. The Shokz OpenRun are the best earbuds for exercise I have a pair of AirPods Pro that I use regularly, but I always set them aside for the OpenRun Pros when I run. The Transparency mode on the AirPods Pro does work well for most situations, but they still can't compare to the awareness you get without having any buds plugging up your ears. In my experience these headphones stay in place extremely well and the sound quality is great compared to other sport headphones I've tried. items.title: GTA 6 Players React After Exclusive Shops Greet Non-Ultimate Edition Buyers With Locked Doors
items.excerpt: GTA 6 players are being locked out of in-game stores because they don't own the Ultimate Edition, and they've got some thoughts about how Rockstar handled it.
items.content_text: GTA 6 players are being locked out of in-game stores because they don't own the Ultimate Edition, and they've got some thoughts about how Rockstar handled it. We've known for months that the developer's latest sprawling open-world video game would have a $79.99 Standard Edition and $99.99 Ultimate Edition to pick up at launch. Those willing to pay the $20 upcharge netted a solid assortment of cosmetics, weapons, vehicles, and unique shops, leaving those who didn't shell out the extra cash with fewer options to choose from when taking Jason and Lucia out into Vice City. Rockstar has been clear about what this would mean for standard owners , but in practice, players are feeling like the door has been (literally) closed in their faces. GTA 6's exclusive in-game shops – One-Eyed Willie's, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, and Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor – are the topic of conversation here. Not everyone was sure how exactly these stores would bar players from entry upon release. It seems, at least based on the consensus from disappointed players, they were expecting to at least be able to enter the locations and not buy anything – but Rockstar doesn't even give them that. GTA 6's Ultimate Edition grants you access to a few stores across Leonida, so what happens when you try to enter them in the Standard Edition? #gta6 https://t.co/GMaHpdLwnc — IGN (@IGN) November 19, 2026 We broke down the Standard vs. Ultimate Edition contents with a side-by-side video that you can check out above. As you can see, the shops have fully decorated interiors that are completely closed off to those who didn't pick up the more expensive version of GTA 6. Those who spent the extra dough can go about their days shopping as they please, while those who didn't have found an unwelcome surprise when heading to any of these spots in Leonida. Being physically locked out of the building is maybe a bit more brutal than some were expecting, but it's the reality players are meeting – and they aren't happy. Comments from disgruntled fans online have called Rockstar's move to keep content blocked off "greedy" and "shady," with many upset that a relatively substantial amount of finished content is only accessible by spending more money. Others are disappointed to see that there wasn't a cheaper compromise, such as making exclusive shops a late-game unlock. Either way, it's the door in the face that seems to sting the most. "I'm all for companies making money - but when you pull the kinda money rockstar is - this just feels greedy/shady," one player said . @IGN https://t.co/BWg2G4TQHk — un1x (@un1x0) November 20, 2026 "Paid $80 just to get bounced from a store like I'm under 21," another replied . "So the Ultimate Edition just locks the door in your face?" another player reacted . "That's the most expensive closed sign I've ever seen." GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. Whether you decided to pick up those extra cosmetic options or not, Rockstar seems to be quite pleased with the release. Earlier today, it noted that it had secured the biggest entertainment launch in history with $3.79 billion in just 24 hours . IGN gave the game a 10/10 review . items.title: Fallout-Themed AriZona Iced Tea Gets Black Friday Discount, Including New 'Apocalyptic Orange' Flavor
items.content_text: Amazon’s Black Friday sale is officially live , making it a great time to pick up some serious bulk of whatever your drink of choice is. Mine happens to be AriZona Iced Tea, because who can hate cheap caffeine, and I’ll certainly never complain about a deal dropping those prices even further. The 15oz Fallout edition teas only come in 12-can packs, priced at around $2/can. Don’t worry, AriZona still maintains its 99-cent MSRP for non-licensed drinks — founder Don Vultaggio makes sure of that. The Amazon discount only knocks off a couple of bucks, but it brings every Fallout can closer to that beautiful standard price. Amazon Discounts Fallout AriZona Green Tea Packs for Black Friday If the Fallout vibes aren't calling to you, you can also find discounts on most of AriZona’s standard flavors . The 15% discount is available on 12-can cases of individual flavors as well as the bulk variety pack. All packs have the same base price, so the decision really comes down to your flavor preferences. Your Fallout options consist of three Vault-Tec reimaginings of AriZona classics – Atomic Red Apple, Wastelander Sweet Peach, and Power Pomegranate – and Apocalyptic Orange, a new flavor unique to the collaboration. The flavors are tied to specific characters from Amazon’s live-action series, depicted in playing card illustrations on the packaging of each case. Lucy gets apple and the Ghoul gets peach, while Dogmeat and pre-war Ghoul adorn the low-cal versions. The collaboration also doubled up on Maximus drinks, with orange dedicated to the man and pomegranate dedicated to his Power Armor. I guess it could be someone else in the suit, but I leave that up to your interpretation. Amazon’s Fallout TV show has brought a whole new audience to Bethesda’s post-apocalyptic world . The series aired its second season earlier this year, and a third season should be coming to Prime Video at some point in 2027. Bethesda, on the other hand, has turned its attention back to the world of Elder Scrolls. The company announced Sentinel as the name of the next game, though it likely won’t arrive for several more years . Bethesda confirmed Fallout 5 won’t be coming until after the next Elder Scrolls, so it might be quite the wait until we get a new journey in the Wasteland.

items.title: Jensen Huang Allegedly Threatened Nvidia Workers and Told Employee He Would Rip Off the Top of Their Head and 'Pee on Your Brain'
items.excerpt: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang allegedly threatened employees with violence and "humiliated" them for decades.
items.content_text: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang allegedly threatened employees with violence and "humiliated" them for decades. According to sources speaking to The New York Times , Huang — who stepped down as Nvidia's CEO amid a scandal involving infidelity and alleged espionage — has a history of using threatening language against employees. Several alleged quotes from Huang are cited in the report, including an incident where Huang reportedly told an employee he wanted to rip their head off and "pee on [their] brain." In another incident, he is quoted as saying, "You have to do this, or I will rip your f***ing heart out and stomp on it." Others described an incident in which he allegedly went around a room and said he would kill managers, and allegedly said that everyone hoped an employee in their 70s would die soon. He is also alleged to have told a member of staff: "I’d rather torture you into greatness, because I believe in you." It is further claimed that he described receiving verbal humiliation like this as a "rite of passage" at Nvidia. This language was described as "foundational" to Huang's style of leadership, and is said to date back to the 2000s. The New York Times said some employees who complained about Huang's behaviour received settlements, and that HR was aware of his alleged behaviour. One settlement was made with the former senior vice president of HR, Michael Winston, it was claimed. Winston was said to have described Huang's behaviour as "verbally abusive, threatening and intimidating." It is reported that his settlement totaled more than $1 million. Huang denied Winston’s allegations in a statement issued to The New York Times. Nvidia declined to comment. Earlier this week, Huang said he was ready to return to the company he co-founded , while apologizing for the problems he'd caused both Nvidia and his family. In a statement, Huang insisted he would be willing to return as CEO if Nvidia's Board of Directors decided it was in the best interest in the company. Some Nvidia employees and other tech CEOs have rallied to Huang's defense and called for him to be reinstated as CEO. The New York Times report alluded to this, acknowledging that Huang does have a following within Nvidia. The attitudes towards Huang are described as "cultish" in the report, with the former CEO alternating between praise and ridicule. It is alleged that he "ruled through fear." Huang is reportedly due to appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China Select Committees on December 1. items.content_text: Kaiji Tang, the English voice actor behind iconic anime characters like Jujutsu Kaisen’s Satoru Gojo and Demon Slayer’s Sanemi Shinazugawa, was left stunned after learning that he had unknowingly recorded lines for GTA 6. It seems like some of GTA 6 ’s cast are just now learning that they were featured in the game, as evidenced by a few posts circling online a day after its official global release. One of these cast members is prominent voice actor Kaiji Tang, known for providing the English voice for several main characters in popular series like The Apothecary Diaries , Kengan Ashura, and Baki , just to name a few. In the early morning hours of November 19, Tang posted on X/Twitter confirming he was in Rockstar’s highly anticipated crime-sim. However, he revealed that he wasn’t aware the lines he recorded were going to be used in this particular game, leading to a hilarious interaction with a fan. “I had no idea what I recorded was for this game,” he wrote. “Imagine my shock.” “Considering they had you saying, ‘Sit on daddy’s lap,’ I’m curious what you thought it was for,” a fan replied. “I dunno, Demon Slayer?” Tang answered. i had no idea what i recorded was for this game imagine my shock lol — Kaiji Von Tang (@KaijiTang) November 19, 2026 @actualcannibal i dunno demon slayer? — Kaiji Von Tang (@KaijiTang) November 20, 2026 Tang is a major figure in the voice acting business with an extensive portfolio under his belt, so it’s no surprise to learn that he lent his talents to GTA 6. Aleks Le, another popular voice actor in anime and video games, revealed that he also contributed to the project, and even said that he asked the directors for permission to include one of his famous lines from Street Fighter 6 — though it’s still unclear if that particular phrase made it into the final product. Tang isn’t the only actor just now learning they’re in GTA 6; athlete, author, and influencer ‘Jessishiking’ revealed that they were also just now made aware of their involvement in the game. In a celebratory post on Facebook, Jess revealed that they played the GTA series’ first-ever nonbinary character (which, to avoid spoilers, we won’t name here). They said that they were required to sign several NDAs and had no idea what they were filming for at the time due to the extreme secrecy around the game. “Absolutely wild to find out THIS was the super-secret game I spent weeks and 17 NDAs filming 3 years ago,” they wrote in their post. “Some fun facts: GTA was one of the most inclusive and caring sets I’ve ever been on. I shot this back in my they/them days, and everyone on production ensured I was comfortable and gendered correctly. At the time I wasn’t allowed to know what I was shooting — I didn’t get confirmation until TODAY that it was, indeed, GTA 6.” While the game’s full credits have since been revealed, it’s highly possible that we see more posts like this in the coming days from voice actors and performers excitedly learning that the secret project they recorded lines for many years ago is the biggest entertainment product of all time. It features true Dolby Atmos support and a built-in Sound Motion woofer that pumps out impressive bass even without a discrete sub. Save $250 Off the Sonos Arc Ultra Soundbar Given the number of upgrades, the Sonos Arc Ultra should be considered more as a new class of flagship soundbar than a mere update of the original Arc. At first glance, both look similar, with the same 46" long profile, but the internals are totally different. Whereas the Arc featured a 5.0.2ch setup with eleven speakers and no sub, the Arc Ultra boasts an expanded 9.4.1ch setup with fourteen speakers including a four-motor, dual-membrane Sound Motion woofer for better bass response and low end. This is a pretty significant upgrade alone if you don't plan on adding a discrete subwoofer. The Arc Ultra also supports Dolby Atmos thanks to two dedicated up-firing tweeters for spatial audio and new AI enhancement technology to isolate and boost the clarity of dialogue and voices. It has a built-in microphone so that it can be controlled using voice commands using your favorite smart assistant. Check out our own Sonos Arc Ultra review . The Sonos Sub (Gen 4) subwoofer is also on sale The audio savvy knows that a single speaker isn't enough to reproduce an entire soundstage. If you could pick only one other speaker, then a subwoofer would make the most meaningful impact. The Sonos Sub 4 has hit a new price low during the recertified sale. It's currently priced at $719, a savings of 20%. The Sub 4 features dual inward-facing 5"x8" woofers and a traditional ported design that allows for a louder and deeper low-end. It also has much more power than the Sub Mini and can reverberate the walls of any sized room in your house. New for 2026: Sonos Beam Ultra Soundbar The Sonos Beam Ultra is more than just an incremental upgrade over its Gen 2 predecessor. Like the Arc Ultra compared to the Arc , this is practically an entirely different soundbar. Although the size profile isn't much different (29 inches long vs 25 inches), the Beam Ultra now houses a total of nine total speakers instead of five. This improves the Beam's surround sound capabilities two-fold: (1) it is now technically a 7.1.2ch system instead of 5.1.2ch and (2) it has two physical upfiring speakers for true Dolby Atmos support whereas the previous Beam Gen 2 used virtual height channels for a simulated Atmos experience. Other upgrades include AI speech enhanced to isolate and amplify dialogue, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and USB-C line-in. It also has a microphone for voice control. New for 2026: Sonos Ace Ultra Headphones The Sonos Ace Ultra has also undergone major renovation, which isn't as surprising since the original Ace was Sonos' first foray into the world of over-ear headphones. The Ace Ultra is better sounding than ever before thanks to a combination of second generation custom engineered 40mm drivers and adaptive EQ that tunes the sound in real time based on how the headphones fit. Noise cancelation has also improved up to 2X with the presence of ten microphones instead of eight. An interesting feature unique to the Sonos Ace Ultra is the replaceable battery. All lithium batteries lose maximum charge over time. And most of the time, the only solution is to replace the headphones. Sonos, however, allows you to buy a replacement battery kit that you can install yourself. It's not hard, Sonos provides instructions, and it doesn't void your warranty. although it's not completely toolless. items.title: Macaulay Culkin to Return as Kevin McCallister in Home Alone Sequel
items.excerpt: Macaulay Culkin has reportedly signed on to return as Kevin McCallister in a new Home Alone sequel for Disney.
items.content_text: Macaulay Culkin has reportedly signed on to return as Kevin McCallister in a new Home Alone sequel for Disney. Details on the original child actor's return to the franchise were originally reported by Puck . The project, which would see Culkin slip back into the mind of one of the most mischievous characters in movie history, is said to be in early development at Disney – and it's already got other interesting names attached, too. Included in the lineup of talent in the mix are The Studio and This Is the End collaborators Evan Goldberg and Seth Rogen. The comedy duo have signed on via their Point Grey banner to produce the Home Alone follow-up and will also help Culkin hammer out the details of the movie's plot. There have been a number of Home Alone sequels since Culkin helped launch the classic Christmas franchise in the '90s, but most would agree that it's been hard to top the story of the McCallister family. Only the original film and its Lost in New York sequel managed to capture the kind of holiday magic that has brought viewers back in droves through the decades, and that's largely thanks to Culkin's performance. The now-grown actor has remained the literal poster child for Home Alone for all this time, and in 2026, he's not just ready to come back as Kevin; he apparently pitched the idea himself. Deadline corroborated Puck's reporting and explained the extent of Culkin's involvement in its own piece. The star is said to have pitched his idea for a Home Alone return to Disney Motion Pictures boss David Greenbaum over the summer. One early idea Culkin had involved bringing Kevin back on the big screen as an older, wiser version of the character who also happens to be a dad now. Whether Kevin would be forgetting his own children at home or dealing with burglars himself yet again remains to be seen, and it's unclear if anything from Culkin's early pitch will make it into the final picture. It's been 34 years since the star last ( officially ) played the abandoned McCallister boy, so should the early-in-development movie eventually come to be, it will bring an end to decades of fans asking for him to return. Culkin's return as Kevin would mark his third time playing the character and the seventh entry in the franchise. The last, a Disney+ exclusive called Home Sweet Home Alone , premiered in 2021 and starred Archie Yates, Ellie Kemper, and Rob Delaney. IGN gave it a 6/10 review , saying that it "contains wit and heart, if not also clumsy messaging and some tonal misfiring." For more, you can see Culkin defend his stance that Die Hard is not a Christmas movie . You can also read about how original director Chris Columbus is apparently not a fan of those sequels. items.excerpt: Rockstar Games has confirmed GTA 6 retail sales reached $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, securing its place as the biggest entertainment launch of all time.
items.content_text: Rockstar Games has confirmed GTA 6 retail sales reached $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, securing its place as the biggest entertainment launch of all time. Parent company Take-Two Interactive announced the news today. Rockstar founder and president Sam Houser shared his feelings about the landmark achievement in a statement. "It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI," he said. "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn’t be more excited to share this moment with you." After quickly emerging as the highest-rated video game of all time , breaking records across streaming sites , and causing wild spikes in internet traffic , we all kind of knew this was coming. After 13 years, Rockstar has pulled off the greatest score anyone has ever seen. Even in this new update, Take-Two said it was "proud" to help GTA 6 adopt its new crown. Earning $3.79 billion in 24 hours is unheard of across any medium, meaning Rockstar's new Grand Theft Auto game didn't just stomp on launch sales for games like Red Dead Redemption 2, Cyberpunk 2077, or any Call of Duty game; it crushed any blockbuster movie release ever, too. It's still got a ways to go before claiming any titles like 'best all-time sales,' but it's a start better than anyone has ever seen in the history of gaming. Just yesterday, it was reported that GTA 6 had managed to sell more than 20 million pre-order copies . Courtesy of Take-Two today, we now know that, somehow, these already staggering numbers actually significantly undershot the reality. The company has now confirmed that it actually moved 32.5 million pre-sale units alone. That's more copies than the vast majority of games have ever sold. Meanwhile, how many non-pre-ordered copies have been sold after launch is unclear. GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. If this news is anything to go by, Rockstar is just getting started. IGN gave the game a 10/10.
